commands.review_summary:
The PR adds deterministic dispatch receipt keys, recoverable durable command claims, receiver-side receipt dedupe for assist and repair workflows, active-run matching for keyed repair runs, focused tests, and a changelog entry.

Reproducibility: yes. by source inspection, though I did not run live GitHub dispatches. Two same-key assist or repair workflow runs can be visible to each other, and the new `any(... id != current)` receipt check lets both decide they are duplicates.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow automated repair can make the receipt gates choose one winner and add regression coverage without needing a product or security decision.

target.title: fix: recover interrupted command dispatches
target.body:
## What changed

This keeps the useful pre-dispatch claim from #380, but makes the claim recoverable instead of terminal.

- Every review, assist, and repair dispatch now carries a deterministic receipt key.
- A retry first looks for the exact Actions run created after the durable claim. It recovers that receipt when present, waits through GitHub's visibility window, and retries only a stale claim with no receipt.
- The receiving queue and workflows deduplicate the same receipt key, so even a delayed first delivery plus a retry can execute only once.
- The review path no longer falls back to an untraceable second dispatch mechanism.
- Active repair detection recognizes keyed run names, and the waiting claim keeps its original timestamp.

This replacement was necessary because the contributor branch allows maintainer edits but the available personal OAuth authorization cannot update workflow files. The final tree preserves and extends @ag-linden's work, with co-author credit in both commits.

## Proof

- Crash/retry runtime smoke: `crash_before_dispatch=wait`, `crash_after_dispatch=recover`, `stale_without_receipt=dispatch`.
- Focused router/workflow/capacity tests: 180 passed.
- Full `pnpm run check`: 600 unit tests and 608 repair tests passed.
- Changed coverage: 100% lines, 89.17% branches, 100% functions.
- Overall coverage: 76.67% lines, 70.66% branches, 83.97% functions.
- Build, lint, formatting, active-surface, workflow-input, and automation-limit checks passed.
- AutoReview: no accepted or actionable findings; patch correct at 0.78 confidence.

## Risk

Medium. This changes command-dispatch recovery and three receiving workflows. API-read failures fail closed, claims wait five minutes before stale recovery, and receiver-side receipt checks prevent duplicate execution.

Replaces #380.
